title: How is Diddy connected to George Washington?
description: A real photo links Diddy to Donald Trump, and the line of presidents runs from Trump back to George Washington.
hook: How is Diddy connected to George Washington?

image.credit: Sonia Moskowitz / Getty Images, via Hot 97

links.line: In 1998, Diddy and Donald Trump posed together at a celebrity polo match in the Hamptons.
And in 2025, Trump became the 47th president, in a line going back to George Washington.
